title: Showroom · Aaryan The One, Satellite
address: Bileshwar Mahadev Mandir Rd, Jodhpur Gam Rd, Satellite, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380015
description: Showroom space in Aaryan The One on Jodhpur Gam Road, Satellite, with 4,000 sq.ft super built up and 2,200 sq.ft carpet on the ground floor, plus a generous 45 ft frontage.

Part of a G+4 retail development with two lifts and sixteen showrooms per floor, currently under construction. Rent is quoted at ₹120 per sq.ft on super built up or ₹218 per sq.ft on carpet. Well suited to a cafe, restaurant, fashion or designer label, salon or gym.
